Reshape co-treatment differences to one row per drug and co-treatment concentration

Source: R/plot-chemical_genomics.R
dot-cgs_diff_by_cotrt.Rd

prep_dt_response_metric_diff returns one difference column per metric and co-treatment concentration (e.g. RV_gDR_x_mean_cotrt_diff_0.03_drug_1). A cell line screened at one concentration has NA in the columns of the others, so the columns are stacked into one column per metric, with the concentration in column cotrt. Rows without any value at a concentration are dropped.

Usage

.cgs_diff_by_cotrt(metrics_diff)

Arguments

metrics_diff

data.table returned by prep_dt_response_metric_diff.

Value

data.table with the identifier columns, cotrt and one column per metric.
